difficulties.name: DIFFICULTY 0
difficulties.description: The source binds diff_0.asset but has no difficulty name or modifiers.

rules.selection: Exactly one of w1..w6 is enabled; selecting another disables the other five.
rules.weapon_default: All six source weapon roots are inactive until a weapon button is clicked.
rules.six_slot_status: Weapons(1/6) is display-only; there is no six-slot equipment, duplication, sale or replacement logic.
rules.difficulty: Only one item is a Button. Its calls toggle UI GameObjects, including four null targets; there are no gameplay modifiers.
rules.difficulty_default: The only item's Select and Next are already active when the difficulty panel opens.
rules.navigation: Character Next -> weapon; weapon Next -> difficulty; difficulty Next -> StartGame, enable Container and StartSpawningS.
rules.weapon_back: Back buttons change page visibility but do not clear the active weapon. Weapon Next hides highlights and itself.
rules.migration: DIFFICULTY 0 is a readable label inferred from diff_0.asset, not an original text label; no multipliers are added.
